name: 巴纳德环 · 1倍猎户广域
note: Finkbeiner v1.1 Halpha Rayleigh map reprojected on 44-degree TAN support. 6 arcmin nominal resolution (WHAM-only regions coarser). This NEW morphology view estimates flagged gaps from nearest valid neighbour; count is recorded; original masked line package is unchanged. No independent OIII: zero band is omitted from scene layers, NOT labelled measured zero. Added stars have real Hipparcos ICRS J1991.25 positions and Vmag<9; no proper-motion correction, faint-star completeness or individual stellar spectrum claim. Assumed 6000K spectral shape and 2e-8 W/m² integrated 300–1100nm flux for V=0, not calibrated catalogue spectrophotometry. Same existing local sky is added once; Galactic Halpha is already in this map.
processing: All brightness/line decomposition is an engineering morphology hypothesis.
No new simulated noise or physical tube halo is baked into templates.
TAN coordinates, row0 south, columns increase west.
Uint16 linear quantization; absolute error <= half of each stored scale.
